about: Findings of tools/security/scan_secrets.js accepted at a given file line. Entries are { path, rule, lineSha256, reason }: lineSha256 is the sha256 of the whole line, never the text. An entry that matches nothing in a scan that read its file fails as STALE_ALLOWLIST. Empty on purpose: the rules are tuned so policy text and look-alikes are not findings.
